india.one_line: Sarvam AI launched a speech-to-text API, while Nasscom and Systematix addressed AI adoption in Indian IT.

themes.title: Sarvam AI launches multilingual speech API
themes.text: Sarvam AI released a speech-to-text API supporting English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 per minute.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI launches Dictate API for English and 22 Indian languages

themes.title: AI adoption shapes IT sector policy and demand
themes.text: Nasscom proposed a three-year AI scheme for IT firms in its pre-Budget recommendations, as a report noted AI adoption will sustain demand while pressuring labor models.

stories.headline: Nasscom proposes three-year AI scheme for Indian IT firms in Budget 2027-28
Systematix report: AI adoption to sustain Indian IT services demand, labor models pressured
